description: Automerge every non-major grouped update as soon as the PR's own checks pass. Renovate's automerge is used rather than GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge: false) because native auto-merge needs branch-protection required checks, which this repository does not rely on.
Major updates and vulnerability alerts are never automerged: a major bump carries the major-update label and a security fix carries the security label, and both wait for a human.
lockFileMaintenance is intentionally absent: no lockfile is tracked (uv.lock is git-ignored) and dependencies are >= bounds resolved fresh on every run, so there is nothing to maintain.
